## Purpose

Describe the trust, evaluation or security problem this change solves.

## Evidence

- [ ] Success, failure and hostile-input paths are tested
- [ ] Framework-neutral contracts remain stable or migrations are documented
- [ ] `ruff`, `mypy`, `pytest --cov` and `mkdocs build --strict` pass
- [ ] User-facing behavior and limitations are documented

## Security and compatibility

Describe policy, evidence, state, dependency and adapter implications. Do not include secrets or live exploit data.
